_readme: PVill demo families, part 2. Adds to sample-data.json (KAN-26); nothing here changes or removes what it loaded.
EVERYTHING in this file is made up. No real person, organization, or address. Emails use .example.
Givers and items named by id (casey, sample-community-closet, item-02...) are the ones in sample-data.json.
Each family's story is told by the profile answers the app asks for. The app stores no story text.
Claims put each family's My claims in a set state so every claim screen has something to show on first open.
createdDaysAgo dates a claim back. Active claims (approved, waiting) are re-timed by Refresh demo pickup dates.
Photos are simple drawings in demo-photos/. They show no house numbers, street signs or people.

families.story: 19 and aging out of foster care, with a newborn. Needs the basics and somewhere stable to live.
families.tryThis: Log in as Jade. My claims shows an Approved hold on Size 2 diapers with the pickup place and Add to calendar. Past shows a Picked up bottle kit. Home shows housing help.

families.story: A grandparent raising two grandchildren, a toddler and a preschooler.
families.tryThis: Log in as Pat. My claims shows an Approved hold on the pack and play. Past shows a clothing bundle whose hold ended, so it went back on the list. Kinship resources rank high.

families.story: A single dad with a baby, learning feeding and the first year on his own.
families.tryThis: Log in as Andre. My claims shows a Waiting request for Morgan's baby bath tub, with no address yet. Log in as Morgan to approve it, then back as Andre to see the place.

families.story: A two-parent family with a toddler and a second baby on the way. They get help and give back.
families.tryThis: Log in as Sam. My claims shows an Approved claim on Casey's baby carrier, with Casey's exact pickup place because Casey approved it. Sam can also post items.
